geography: Bihar only: v024 decoded value label 'Bihar' or audited --state-code; never silently infer an unlabeled numeric code
reference_period: Interview CMC minus birth CMC, integer 0-59 inclusive; 13-59 for binary complete follow-up

datasets.binary: Age 13-59 CMC months at interview, outcome death before 12 completed months from b5 and b7; not official period IMR
datasets.monthly_survival: Age 0-59 CMC months at interview, 0-11 discrete monthly age bins; alive censored conservatively at max(0,v008-b3-1) and endpoint 12 months; deceased before 12 events in b7 month+1
datasets.official_rate: Separate DHS synthetic-cohort period estimation, survey design and DHS.rates crosscheck; NOT implemented or substituted by model cohort

allowed_at_birth_features: maternal age at birth from b3-v011
prohibited_primary_features: wealth/education measured at interview without verified temporal validity
birth weight before availability and without missingness audit

design.strata: audit v022/v023 and which encodes actual NFHS stratum
design.grouping: PSU-held-out primary; mother/household never cross partitions
design.calibration: report weighted Brier, calibration slope/intercept and curves
design.stratified_ci: not implemented until strata and replicate methods verified

primary_binary.nonevent: b5=1 at 13+ CMC months OR b5=0 and b7>=12
primary_binary.exclude: missing invalid b5/b7, temporal anomalies and nonpositive weights

survival.zero_exposure: keep audit, exclude from month-bin table; never count as 12-month survivors
survival.precision: month-level CMC and b7 ages have reporting/imputation uncertainty

neonatal.positive_only_if: b6 is verified 100..127 day-coded with 0..27 days
neonatal.ambiguous_if: b7=0 without valid day-coded b6; month 0; infant alive less than 2 CMC months
neonatal.negative_if: reported b6 days>=28 or completed months>=1, OR infant alive >=2 CMC months
neonatal.warning: No exact neonatal or 0-2 day risk using b7=0 alone

validation.split: PSU-held-out independent folds; household/mother cannot leak
validation.model_selection: predefine baselines and hyperparameter search on development set only
validation.uncertainty: strata and PSU design-based variance requires independent implementation; weighted ML metrics alone do not suffice
validation.fairness: prespecified education, wealth, urban/rural, district only if sample sizes permit; no unverified causal claims

frozen_status: DO NOT alter fixed definitions after seeing observed mortality labels; amendments must be versioned with reason and timestamp
microdata_status: AUTHORIZED NFHS-5 individual BR not yet available; no patient-level results claimed
